enzyme_name: abietadienol/abietadienal oxidase (CYP720B1 / PtAO), a cytochrome P450 monooxygenase
organism_context: Conifers (Pinus taeda, Picea spp.) - diterpene resin acid biosynthesis; ModelSEED instead annotates generic ALDH [NAD(P)+] EC 1.2.1.5
rationale: Oxidation of the C20 diterpene aldehyde neoabietadienal to its resin acid is done in planta by the multisubstrate P450 CYP720B1/PtAO (O2 + NADPH), not by an NAD(P)+-dependent ALDH; PtAO is called 'multifunctional' only because one heme site performs consecutive C18 oxidations on many diterpenol/diterpenal substrates, which is iterative single-activity catalysis rather than fused catalytic domains. No enzyme performs the equation as written, because it pairs neoabietadienal with arachidonate, an unrelated straight-chain C20 acid.
direction_note: Aldehyde -> free carboxylate oxidation is physiologically irreversible (Heider & Hege: catalytic residues of irreversibly acting ALDHs are universally conserved, and only activated acids such as acyl-CoA/acyl-phosphate can be reduced back), so ModelSEED's '<' (NAD(P)H reduction of a free acid) has no enzymatic basis; ModelSEED itself flags this entry charge-imbalanced (CI:-2).
